sections.title: Privacy
sections.text:
When you order, we keep your name, email, phone (if given), shipping address and what you bought, so we can make and send your order and you can follow it under My orders. We never sell or share it, except with the delivery company and the payment service that need it.

If you sign up for emails, we keep your email address and the date you agreed. Every newsletter has an Unsubscribe link, and you can ask us to remove you at any time.

To make the shop better, we count which pages and bracelets are looked at, using a random code stored in your browser. It isn't used for ads. Choose "No thanks" in the privacy notice and we stop. Browsers set to "Do Not Track" or "Global Privacy Control" are never counted.

To see, correct or delete what we have about you, contact us.
